# FG-LLM-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `secret_in_input_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この内容は AI に渡せないため、AI の助言はありません（秘密の情報を含むか、大きすぎます）。
- en: This content cannot be given to the AI, so there is no AI advice (it holds secrets or is too large).
- id: Konten ini tidak dapat diberikan ke AI, sehingga tidak ada saran AI (berisi rahasia atau terlalu besar).

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §5 (06 D-5): the input of a request was refused before any model saw it (`forge_core::llm::prepare`). `reason`: `secret_unredactable` (a private key block whose end is missing: what follows its header cannot be told apart from the key), `too_many_secrets` (more secrets than the input may hold redacted, 64 by default), `too_many_assignments` (more than 256 secret-looking names on one line: the rest of the line cannot be shown to be clean), `too_large` (more characters than the purpose's bound after redaction), `empty` (no part: a bug of the input builder). Secrets that can be redacted are replaced by `[REDACTED:<kind>]` and the request goes on; this code is only for inputs that cannot be sent at all.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The caller logs it with `purpose`, `reason`, `label` (the part: `diff`, `log`, …) and, for `too_many_secrets`, `redactions`, `max_chars` for `too_large`. The input itself is never logged or stored; reproduce it from the request's keys (the merge request's head and base SHAs, the log's request_id).

## 対処 (fix)

`secret_unredactable` / `too_many_secrets`: the source holds credentials — rotate them (a committed secret is a leak) and remove them; `too_large`: the input builder must split or trim the input (a defect of the purpose's builder). `empty`: a builder bug, fix it.
